spec.name: Halloween Bottled Whisper
spec.description: A slender glass vial containing a curled lavender whisper, sealed with a worn copper stopper and a knotted purple ribbon. Original Orange SMP Halloween item with transparent glass, open ribbon silhouette, and axis-aligned editable cuboids.

prompt: Slim glass vial holding a pale lavender curled wisp of mist, copper stopper and purple ribbon. Original Orange SMP Halloween asset. Vanilla Minecraft pixel scale, material-specific irregular detail, developed UV-mapped surfaces and purposeful connected cuboids. No text, no unrelated scene, no stands, no animations, no bones except the required armor rig. Preserve transparent negative space. Model geometry must be axis-aligned, with no rotated elements. Use local vanilla references for glass, pumpkin rind, wood, iron and inventory sprites. Generated artwork will be used directly in a Paper resource pack.
